title: The Story We Tell About a Mistake
short_teaser: A mistake can become proof that we are incapable, or it can become information about a method, assumption, or condition.
story: A mistake can become proof that we are incapable, or it can become information about a method, assumption, or condition. The event matters, but the interpretation shapes what happens next. Reflection gives us a chance to revise the story without denying responsibility. Reflection turns experience into guidance. The goal is not to stay in the past, but to carry forward what the past can teach. The lasting value is not merely knowing the fact. It is seeing the pattern beneath it and considering where that same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
